description: Single source of truth for the Levela post-guest onboarding flow (welcome, goal, profile, weight, height, activity). scripts/verify_onboarding_parity.sh checks that the Android and iOS Onboarding features expose the same steps, copy, units, defaults, value ranges, goals, sex options, activity levels, colours and welcome illustration. Colour names refer to the primitive labels in THEME_COLORS.md.
